text:
mia: Quick ping — I'm updating the Security & Compliance doc with a tenant data flow diagram and need phrasing for audit log retention + example snippet for SDK. @jordan @samir any preferences? :thinking:

jordan: thanks — we should be explicit about retention TTL and redaction boundaries. default 90 days for metadata, 365 for legal holds, and PII redaction on ingest. keep wording non-technical.

samir: Agree. For SOC2, prefer 'retention period' language and mention 'records required by law' exception. Also call out that tenants can request exports.

mia: rough snippet i'm planning to include:

```json
{
  "event_type": "api.request",
  "tenant_id": "<tenant-id>",
  "timestamp": "2025-10-01T12:34:56Z",
  "payload": { "path": "/v1/generate", "status": 200 },
  "retention_policy": "metadata:90d,payload:30d",
  "redaction": "pii-removed-on-ingest"
}
```

mia: want to make sure "retention_policy" field wording doesn't imply automatic deletion of tenant-owned content. Keep it about platform logs only.

jordan: change suggestion: use 'audit_retention' instead of 'retention_policy' — less ambiguous. And add comment that 'payload' may be truncated/hashed for privacy.

samir: Wording suggestion for the paragraph under diagram: "Audit logs are retained according to platform audit retention schedules (audit_retention). Tenant content is not deleted by the platform without explicit tenant request or legal requirement." short and SOC2-friendly.

mia: ok i'll update. Also adding a tiny ASCII flow for the diagram alt-text:

```
User -> API -> Redwood Inference (ingest -> KV cache -> storage)
Audit branch: transport -> collector -> audit-store (metadata, payload-hash)
```

dev-docs-bot: link-check failed for docs link: <https://redwood.internal/docs/soc2/flows> — 404

mia: thanks — i'll fix the link and ping for a final quick-review.

jordan: :thumbsup: looks good. add note about legal hold override (1-year default + case-by-case).

samir: approve after minor phrasing tweak on 'tenant content' -> 'tenant data subject to customer controls'

mia: will push a PR in ~30m and tag you both. Thanks!"
